_note: Survival Mode gate timings. Times in seconds; distances in 1920x1080 pixels; frequencies in radians per unit of their span.

close._note: fade_out_s: the gate closing; the halves meet at shut_at (part of the fade-out), then shake by shake_px, wobbling shake_freq_x / shake_freq_y

title._note: the letters start falling within arrive_s, at most step_max_s apart (less for long titles); one letter falls for fall_s from start_scale, fall_ease the power of its slow-down. The title shows show_after_s more, then fades over fade_s; the gate then opens over open_s.

jolt._note: each landed letter shakes the gate for length_s: amplitude amp_px decaying by e every decay_s, at freq_x / freq_y radians per second; phase_y is the extra y phase per letter

dust._note: over its life a puff grows from start_scale by grow, drifts travel px off the seam and turns turn_deg; when the gate opens it lives the first open_life of the opening at open_strength
